card.securityText: We keep uploads private and secure.

errors.unsupportedType: Only PDF, DOCX, or TXT resumes are supported.
errors.unsupportedTypeHint: Upload a PDF or DOCX, or paste plain text.
errors.tooLargeHint: Compress the resume and try again.
errors.readFailed: We couldn't read that text file.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read selectable text from that file.
errors.unreadableHint: Upload a text-based PDF/DOCX or paste your resume text. Scanned or image-only files aren't supported yet.

warnings.title: Resume Parsing Alerts
warnings.preview_truncated: Preview may be incomplete. Sign in to process the full resume.
warnings.missing_contact: No email or phone number detected. Please check your contact details.
warnings.incomplete_contact: We may have missed your contact details. Please review or add them.
warnings.contact_suggestion: We found a profile link but no email or phone. Adding them helps recruiters reach you.
warnings.short_summary: Professional summary is missing or very short. A strong summary helps ATS matching.
warnings.no_experience: No work experience found. If you have experience, please ensure it is clearly listed.
warnings.missing_work_location: Some job entries are missing location (City, Country). This is often required for local jobs.
warnings.incomplete_education: We may have missed your education — please review or add it.
warnings.no_certs: No certifications found. Adding relevant certs can boost your match score.
warnings.incomplete_certs: We may have missed your certifications — please review or add them.
warnings.possible_missing_certs: Your summary mentions certifications, but none were parsed into the Certificates section.
warnings.incomplete_languages: We may have missed your languages — please review or add them.
warnings.unreadable_file: We couldn't read selectable text from that file. Upload a text-based PDF/DOCX or paste your resume text.
